items.lede: Google's negative cash flow balloons to -$9.06 billion, and stock price tumbles following Q3 earnings.
items.title: Google admits AI search makes less money, but it's fixing that with more ads

items.lede: Net profit slid 25% from a year earlier to $26.2bn, well short of expectations, though revenue rose to $127.6bn Shares in the Google parent Alphabet fell double digits Wednesday evening into Thursday trading, erasing hundreds of billions of dollars in stock market value from the $4tn tech giant. The company had reported lower-than-expected profit and a slowdown in its advertising
items.title: Google owner Alphabet loses $500bn in market value after profit disappoints Wall Street

items.lede: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.
items.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
